description: Seller trust score: check whether a paying agent looks abusive or risky before you accept payment. Scores velocity, failed or refused payments, dispute-like patterns, and new versus established history across the Screwtape.ai seller network. Returns a 0–1 trust score, allow/review/block, risk and reasons. Subject values are hashed with a global network HMAC; reporter contributions are weighted by how the reporter paid (per-call payment > prepaid > free) and capped per reporter. window and observations are mutually exclusive. Raw IPs, payer addresses and keys are never stored. $0.005 per call (shared free tier; no monthly plan).

lookback_hours.description: How far back stored signals are read. Default 24.

at.description: ISO-8601 time; bucketed to the UTC day. Defaults to now.

kind.description: payer, agent or caller. The value is hashed immediately and never stored raw.

value.description: Opaque subject id from the seller. Hashed with a global network HMAC shared across sellers; raw value is discarded.

window.description: Optional seller-computed counts for this request only. Mutually exclusive with observations (sending both is rejected). Counts only; no identifiers.

name: trust_score

signals.description: Derived counts only. No subject identifiers.

title: Seller trust score
